# A plan for the importer

The importer reads **every** file once, keeps a _small_ index and writes the report.
It never   touches the originals; a [link](https://example.com) and `inline code` stay as they are.

## Why now

Two paragraphs that repeat a word: the cache, the cache and the cache again.
The second paragraph mentions the cache too.
